title: Nanohybrids for Atopic Dermatitis Therapy
summary: Researchers engineered bio-alkaloid ionic liquid-mesoporous silica nanohybrids for optimized transdermal atopic dermatitis therapy.

title: iEnFlow Attacks Target Apple Silicon Branch Predictors
summary: Researchers introduced iEnFlow, demonstrating endogenous control-flow attacks and speculative exploitation originating purely from the conditional branch predictor on Apple silicon.

title: MChammer Characterizes Rowhammer Countermeasures on DDR5
summary: A systematic study of hardware countermeasures on DDR5-based systems demonstrated end-to-end Rowhammer bit flips and root privilege escalation.

title: Scientists Capture Electrons Making Quantum Jumps in Graphene
summary: Researchers captured electrons making sudden transitions across forbidden energy gaps in graphene with 100% probability.

title: 3D-Printed Frog Swims Using Light-Powered Artificial Muscles
summary: Scientists developed a swimming frog 3D printed with artificial muscles that are powered by light.

title: Shifting HBM4 Controller Functions Closer to Memory
summary: Researchers from UC Riverside published a paper examining the partitioning of HBM controllers across host and base dies for HBM4 memory.

title: Nova Scotia Focuses on Microelectronics Integration
summary: Nova Scotia is prioritizing specialized component and hardware integration for subsea, security, and resource markets instead of building chip fabs.

title: NASA Unveils PROMISE Nuclear Moon Rover
summary: NASA announced plans to send the nuclear-powered PROMISE rover to the Moon's South Pole using repurposed Mars rover components.

title: Jedec Forms New Subcommittee for System Level Reliability Testing
summary: Jedec is creating a new Subcommittee JC-14.8 to address System Level Reliability Testing and is inviting industry participation.

title: Forever Chemical Levels Fall in English Rivers
summary: An Environment Agency assessment revealed that levels of two long-lasting chemicals in England's rivers dropped by about 30% over the past decade.

title: Evaluating NewSpace-Grade NOR Flash Reliability
summary: A new technical paper examines radiation degradation effects in NOR Flash components and proposes a radiation requirement derivation method.

title: Ultra-Compact 16-Foot Tiny House Unveiled
summary: A new unnamed tiny house measuring just 16 feet long features a space-saving interior layout designed to maximize its minimal footprint.

title: Rhoda AI Expands Video Models for Robots
summary: Rhoda AI has extended its direct video action model with mobile DVA to help robots better understand the physical world.

title: Darlington SMR Will Miss 2030 Deadline and Budget
summary: Ontario Power Generation announced that the Darlington SMR project will exceed its budget and miss its October 2030 commercial operation target.

title: Hawk Ridge Systems and M5D Form 3D Printing Alliance
summary: Hawk Ridge Systems and M5D have formed a partnership combining engineering expertise with print technology experience.

title: BYD Unveils Robot-Powered EV Charging Station
summary: BYD has unveiled a charging station combining battery storage, megawatt flash charging, and a robotic automatic plug-in arm.
